sourcePolicy.visualAuthority: Star Wars Saga Edition - Rebellion Era Campaign Guide.pdf

schemaDelta.principle: Rebellion Era extends v2.6 only for source mechanics that cannot be represented faithfully without new structured fields. No production migration is authorized.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].damageMultiplier as a numeric multiplier applied after the structured dice expression; default 1.
why: Miniature Proton Torpedo Launcher single-target mode deals 6d10x2 while the persistent/default area profile remains 6d10.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append damageMultiplier:1 to all prior attack profiles unless a source-certified profile explicitly uses a multiplier. Do not alter base dice.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].conditionalRangeRules[] supporting structured conditional range scaling, including {when, operation, multiplier, appliesTo}.
why: SG-4 blaster mode fired underwater has half range.
SG-4 harpoon mode fired out of water has half range.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append conditionalRangeRules:[] to prior attack profiles. Do not convert legacy repo range strings into source rules.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.resourceProfiles[] for weapons with multiple independent power/ammunition systems. For ordinary single-resource weapons keep [] and retain canonicalStats.resource as before.
why: Energy Lance requires two energy cells to operate and a separate power pack for its blaster-carbine mode.
SG-4 uses a 50-shot power pack for blaster mode and separately loaded harpoon rounds for harpoon mode.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append resourceProfiles:[] to prior records. Populate only when a source explicitly establishes multiple independent resource systems.

schemaDelta.sourceQualityRule: Rebellion Era Table 3-2 uses the standard Accurate rule (no short-range penalty) and Inaccurate rule (cannot fire at long range). Only Siang Lance is marked Accurate; only Flechette Launcher is marked Inaccurate.

bookLocalGuardrails: Do not update a rolling/master weapon authority from this package.
Do not mutate production packs, template/schema runtime, actors, feats, or talents during certification.
Do not create Energy Lance, Power Lance, or Axe during this phase.
Repo fields are comparison evidence only.
Do not resolve the BlasTech 500 Riot Gun Clone Wars vs Rebellion Era precedence conflict in this book-local pass.
Do not create a second Flechette Launcher identity; Rebellion Era and Force Unleashed are the same production identity.
Do not inherit repo Inaccurate onto PLX-2M or Miniature Proton Torpedo Launcher; Rebellion Table 3-2 does not mark them Inaccurate.
Do not flatten SG-4 3d8 blaster and 2d6 harpoon modes into one base damage string.
Do not lose SG-4 explicit 2d8 stun in blaster mode.
Do not collapse Miniature Proton Torpedo Launcher 6d10x2 single-target damage into permanent 6d10x2 base damage.
Do not turn Gas Grenade into ordinary lethal damage; the table prints no normal damage and 4d6 stun plus its Fortitude/condition-track/gas-cloud rules.
Do not replace source damage types with repo kinetic/energy placeholders when the Rebellion tables print Piercing, Bludgeoning, or no type.
Do not infer a new numeric bayonet stat line for Siang Lance; its bayonet use should reference the already-certified Core Bayonet identity.
